description: This is a Go source file implementing a utility for linting Prometheus metrics, including exception handling and problem reporting.

classes.name: Problem
classes.description: Represents an issue detected by the Prometheus metrics linter.

classes.name: Linter
classes.description: A Prometheus metrics linter that identifies issues with metric names, types, and metadata.

methods.name: Lint
methods.description: Performs a linting pass on the metrics stream and returns a list of problems.

methods.name: shouldIgnore
methods.description: Checks if a metric name is in the exception list and should be ignored.

methods.name: NewPromLinter
methods.description: Creates a new Linter instance that reads an input stream of Prometheus metrics.

methods.name: mergeProblems
methods.description: Concatenates a list of problems into a single string message.

methods.name: getLintError
methods.description: Generates an error if there are lint problems not in the exception list.
